results.title: Stratford School System Improvement with Dr. Osunde - Facebook
results.content: The other piece now is that there’s language in the Alliance program that forbids school systems from supplanting, which essentially says, “okay we are going to infuse you with some financial resources but this doesn’t mean that you can cut out of your general budget and replace it”, because essentially you’re just doing the same old thing and that’s been a point of conversation for us in Stratford over the last couple of years. They just do a remarkable job there and as we look to improve our school system it’s taking a look at those aspects of our programming and outcomes that has historically lagged behind and I’m gonna, I haven’t publicly said this in the past okay, but I will say this now: some years ago we were in an administrative meeting, myself and our administrators, and Robert Cherry, a young administrator, and we were unpacking the science and some data work, and one of the things he said, it’s a famous quote, I think it was JFK, he said “rising tide lifts all boats”.
